implementation: One requirements graph per scan, parse/read once per normalized source path; first-encounter DFS declaration evidence once per source/line. Source aliases remain distinct provenance and include bases. Min-depth discovery and per-root remaining-depth closure memo preserve bounded reachability; active/depth guards precede reuse. Same closure determines nonempty all-exact qualification and package set.
independent_review: Separate root-owned final review evidence; final 112 probes announced PASS, not copied into TDD count.
legacy_compatibility: Preserve independent requirements root aggregation, safe non-include diagnostics, and committed R06-G fixed include unreadable on absolute/escape targets.
risk_limits: Static bounded requirements includes do not implement all pip syntax, solve packages, or decide cross-project lock ownership.
Different legal aliases can refer to one inode and are separate source paths/provenance; no once-per-inode promise.
Reuse existing R06-G boundary; concurrent replacement of any resolved component/final target after validation remains outside its guarantee.
